investigation: At the matched 2560 × 1440 view each Sky arm exceeded the 8.33 ms refresh interval. Trace and compose dominate, with constant ray and texture counts. The decks terminate an opaque ray earlier and the fair rays visit many empty samples. The counter includes empty visits and excludes nested Sun samples, so the trace work ratios understate deck work per visit. For the 25% trips, the hemisphere-light dispatch has the same size and consumes clear-air products on every arm. Its increase was 0.09 ms for both decks under changing shared load. The resolve dispatch size also matches. More opaque fronts reach its reprojection branch, but these measurements cannot isolate that cost from contention. Resolve rose from 0.40 ms on fair to 2.71 ms on broken and 0.63 ms on overcast. Keep pass times, input coverage and sample counts for whole-frame tuning.
estimates: CLOUDS DESIGN cost account: weather <0.1 ms, Sun 0.1–0.2 ms, ground <0.05 ms; profiles and resource bytes recorded separately.
